fields.key_provisions: Engrossed proposal requires U.S. processing, storage and disposal of defined state data under covered storage contracts unless the chief procurement officer authorizes otherwise, with exclusions including primarily telecommunications contracts. Credits earned after qualifying contract completion favor Illinois and qualified-area storage for future bids; qualifying data-center RFPs also receive location preference points.

fields.key_provisions: Introduced proposal creates a compensation framework for qualifying property within 1,000 feet of a data center when construction or operation materially and proximately causes specified measurable harm, including property-value or business-revenue loss and qualifying adverse impacts. It provides appraisal and civil-remedy procedures and limits concurrent home-rule powers; proximity alone does not establish compensation eligibility.

fields.key_provisions: Introduced Data Center Construction by Foreign Adversaries Act would bar construction by a foreign company unless ICC, IPA and DCEO jointly study consumption and certify the specified self-generated-load and PJM/MISO conditions. The definition includes an entity at least 51% owned by a foreign adversary or headquartered in a country governed by one.
